_doc: AB-HARNESS-1 (agent_issues 2828). The model each governed worker is declared to use. qnfo-model-eval reads this file from main every hour; a worker whose model here differs from the one it last saw gets a paired A/B run (pre-change baseline against the new model, judged by two other model families) written to qnfo-audit.model_ab_runs, and a regression files an agent_issues row. A worker listed for the first time is only recorded as the baseline. Entry: "<worker>": { "model": "<model id>", "task_set": "grounded-qa|summarize|reasoning-short|clef-classification", "threshold": 0.4, "live_pre": false }. Only model is required. No worker is listed yet: the changes nobody declares are found from ai_call_counters (a model a worker newly uses), so an empty list does not leave a change unmeasured. MODEL-POLICY-SINGLE-SOURCE-1 (agent_issues 2833): `allowed` is the table of models a worker may select, one row per model: id (the qnfo-ai router alias), family (vendor family; panels count families), wa (the Workers AI id a worker pins), ctx (context window in tokens), reasoning (whether it spends output tokens on thought). The rows are the Workers AI rows of the qnfo-ai router catalog (MODELS in qnfo-ai/worker.js); a model a worker uses that is not listed yet, for example @cf/nvidia/nemotron-3-120b-a12b or @cf/qwen/qwen3.8-27b, is added with a ctx taken from its catalog entry, never a guess. scripts/model-floor-guard.mjs reads this table next to its BANNED rules: it validates every row, fails (exit 2) on a row that matches a BANNED rule, and reports a pinned @cf/ id that is not listed (--unlisted; --strict-allowed fails the run). qnfo-model-eval reads only `workers`.
